info.name: HUKMEE API — Active operations
info.description: Contains the mounted write operations and verified technician self-service reads. Write request bodies mirror active Zod validators. No multipart/image upload is implemented. Replace example UUIDs and tokens before use. The collection does not seed or modify a database by itself. Admin catalogue CRUD examples are in the “Admin catalogue CRUD” folder. Catalogue image references and Parts sellingPrice use existing JSON fields; multipart file upload is unavailable and no multipart examples are included. Auth register/login also set an HttpOnly session_token cookie backed by PostgreSQL; Postman can send it automatically for later requests. Existing Bearer token examples remain supported for mobile/API clients. Cookie refresh can be sent with an empty request body. Login/register establish persistent connect.sid Express sessions in the Prisma express_session table, plus the existing revocable refresh-token session cookie.
